title: Active collaboration marker v2 (published read-only contract)
description: One file per collaboration at /tmp/multi-agent-collaboration/_active/<WORKSPACE_UUID>/<COLLABORATION_ID>.json, written by arm_task when identity-gate passes and removed by disarm_task. Concurrent collaborations in one workspace therefore no longer overwrite each other. External read-only consumers — currently the CCC Supervisor TUI's 协作 column — join on surface_uuid, never on surface_ref: refs are renumbered whenever surfaces open or close (the CCC 2026-08-20 ref-join incident). A v2 consumer must treat the marker as active only while now < armed_at + ttl_seconds AND last_activity_at is present, parseable and >= armed_at; a missing or malformed last_activity_at hides the whole marker (no fallback to armed_at). Artifact existence alone is history, not liveness.

marker_version.description: Contract version. Consumers must ignore markers with a version they do not understand rather than guess.

collaboration_id.description: UUID of this collaboration; also the marker filename stem. disarm_task removes exactly this file, never the workspace directory.

artifact_root.description: Absolute artifact directory for this task; heartbeat scope and the reverse-lookup key that routes an artifact write to its owning marker.

workspace_id.description: CMUX_WORKSPACE_ID of the arming process (workspace UUID, also the parent directory name).

workspace_uuid.description: Workspace UUID resolved at arm time; equals workspace_id when armed inside cmux.

role.description: Numbered role enums (executor2/executor3) are retired; executor identity order lives in ordinal.

ordinal.description: Supervisor is exactly ordinal 0; executors are 1..n. Display labels derive from this (single executor: Executor; several: Executor1/Executor2/…), never from array position.

surface_ref.description: Ref at arm time; display/debug only — do not join on it.

surface_uuid.description: Stable surface UUID. Empty string means the UUID could not be resolved at arm time; consumers must then show nothing rather than fall back to the ref.

provider.description: codex / claude / grok / … as detected at arm time.

last_activity_at.description: ISO-8601; bumped by every artifact write under artifact_root (heartbeat). Mandatory: consumers hide the marker when it is missing, malformed or earlier than armed_at.

ttl_seconds.description: Hard expiry relative to armed_at so a stale marker cannot wedge sessions.

$comment: v2 introduced 2026-09-01: per-collaboration files under a workspace directory, role+ordinal participants, exactly one supervisor (ordinal 0) and >=1 executor per marker, no duplicate surface_uuid, mandatory strict last_activity_at. v1 (2026-08-31, single _active/<ws>.json, numbered role enums) remains read-only compatible in consumers; nothing writes it anymore. Markers without marker_version/participants are pre-contract; consumers must ignore them.
